title: CreativeBrief
description: One proposed angle for a job (PRD REQ-030): an audience promise, a hook family, a narrative archetype, evidence-linked proof points, the value delivered, CTA logic, the selected candidate Moments, and known limitations. `propose` returns N of these; REQ-031 requires them to differ by creative thesis, so each carries `distinctness` metadata recording moment overlap and angle. Immutable revision (PRD §5): a revision is a new object with `parentCreativeBriefId` set, never an in-place edit. The model PROPOSES this brief; nothing here is a blocking decision — D-37 keeps model output advisory. REQ-036 refusals are NOT a CreativeBrief; they are the `propose` skill's separate refusal output variant.

changelog.reason: Initial v1 (Phase 3, tech-spec §15 step 5). Models REQ-034 evidence-linking as a required `factOrJudgement` discriminator on every proof point so 'observed fact' and 'model judgement' can never be collapsed, and REQ-031 distinctness as structured data (shared-moment fraction + angle label) so 'deliberately distinct' is checkable rather than asserted. Carries model provenance (PRD §10.6).

sourceBriefId.description: The JobBrief this angle was proposed against (PRD lineage §3). The audience/objective/promise this brief serves come from that JobBrief.

parentCreativeBriefId.description: The CreativeBrief revision this supersedes, or null for the first (REQ-039 revision-without-reindexing lineage).

audiencePromise.description: What THIS angle promises the viewer (REQ-030). REQ-031 lets variants differ on promise OR thesis; the pair below records both so distinctness is auditable.

creativeThesis.description: The angle's core argument (REQ-030 'angle'). REQ-031: variants must differ here or in `audiencePromise` — not merely in clip order or caption colour.

hookFamily.description: Which opening hypothesis this angle tests (REQ-032 Hook Lab). The enum is what makes 'distinct hook' checkable (REQ-031).

narrativeArchetype.description: The story shape this angle uses (REQ-030 'narrative archetype'). Free text, not an enum: archetypes are an open vocabulary at Phase 0 and REQ-033 refuses a fixed arc.

value.description: The emotional or practical value delivered (REQ-030 'emotional or practical value / desired feeling').

proofPoints.description: Claims this angle makes and the on-screen evidence for each (REQ-034 evidence-linked decisions). Every proof point links to the Moments that evidence it; the deterministic editorial gate (D-37) later blocks an EDL whose required-evidence links do not resolve, so this list has teeth.

evidenceMomentIds.description: Moments that evidence the claim. minItems 1: a proof point with no evidence is not a proof point.

basis.title: ProofBasis
basis.description: REQ-034: rationales must distinguish observed facts from model judgement. A tagged union, not a boolean, so the rationale text is bound to the kind — an 'observed_fact' names what was seen on screen, a 'model_judgement' names the inference.

observed.description: What is literally present in the footage (spoken words, on-screen text, a shown action).

inference.description: The model's interpretation — advisory only (D-37), never a blocking signal.

selectedMoments.description: The candidate Moments this angle draws on (REQ-030 'selected source moments'). Each names the narrative function it is proposed to serve — a candidate role, not a committed one; the story planner (`plan`) chooses.

cta.title: CtaLogic
cta.description: This angle's CTA, or an explicit declaration of none (REQ-030 'CTA logic'). Same tagged-union shape as JobBrief.cta so 'we chose no CTA' and 'nobody decided' stay distinct.

distinctness.title: Distinctness
distinctness.description: REQ-031: the system records overlap in source moments and semantic angle so 'deliberately distinct' is data, not a claim. Computed by `propose` across the returned set; peer references let a reviewer see which briefs are near-duplicates.

peerBriefLabels.description: Stable labels of the sibling briefs this one was compared against within the same `propose` run (e.g. `angle-1`, `angle-2`). Labels not IDs, because siblings are all minted in one run and their IDs are not known to each other at generation time.

sharedMomentFraction.description: Fraction of this brief's selected Moments that also appear in at least one peer brief. High overlap with a distinct thesis is fine; high overlap with a similar thesis is the REQ-031 smell the critic surfaces.

semanticAngleLabel.description: A short human-readable label for this brief's angle, used for quick side-by-side distinctness reading.

knownLimitations.description: What this angle cannot fully deliver from the available footage (REQ-030 'known limitations'). An honest limitation here is the constructive half of REQ-036: fewer-with-a-reason beats a padded weak cut.
